messages:
Rae (Comms): All-hands in 12 mins. Two quick asks: trim roadmap to two bullets and confirm stream/recording fallback plan.
Joel (Infra): Encoder healthy. I pushed a reconnect throttle yesterday. If stream drops quick fix: ```ssh encoder01 && sudo systemctl restart streamd``` (usually <15s).
Marta (AV): Mic D at lectern is noisy; I have a lav on standby. Handheld is also an option but will need close speech.
Rae (Comms): Asha wants a 90s intro, then 10m Q&A. If demo causes latency, skip live demo and play pre-recorded clip.
Asha (CEO): Yep short intro: call out Dedicated perf improvement and Private security checklist. Then open to Q&A.
Diego (Product): Slides uploaded: "AH_trim2.pdf" pages 1-2. I'll prepare two rehearsed answers: caching gains and pricing pilot.
Marta (AV): I'll mute monitor for first 20s to avoid bleed and set noise gate on lav. Switching lav channel now.
Joel (Infra): If reconnects persist use FALLBACK_KEY_1997. Command to switch: ```curl -X POST http://encoder/api/switch_key -d 'key=FALLBACK_KEY_1997'```
recording-bot: Reminder: recording starts in 8 minutes. Keep mics muted until hosts cue.
Rae (Comms): Action items: (1) Joel keep restart & key switch ready, (2) Marta swap to lav if lectern flaps, (3) Asha & Diego rehearse handoff. React :thumbsup: when ready.
Joel (Infra): :thumbsup: ready with commands
Marta (AV): :thumbsup: lav live on channel 3
Diego (Product): :thumbsup: rehearse in 5
recording-bot: Recording started at 1997654440
Rae (Comms): Thanks all 609 see you in the room.
